title: Supervise orphan native Nginx workers in owned Docker tests

acceptance_criteria.description: Opt-in cleanup of actual orphan native Nginx workers only, with bounded exact ownership.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Nonroot65534/private disposable PID1 guard; only adopted nginx worker processes, UID/executable identity and pidfd-safe signaling. Never signal live masters/healthy workers/other services or host/unrelated resources. Exact supervisor and source receipts, original catalogues/assertions/timeouts unchanged, no Haskell/native repair or default/deploy change.

acceptance_criteria.description: Prove native orphan cleanup and preservation of healthy workers.
acceptance_criteria.required_evidence: Owned Docker actual pinned native nginx two masters/workers; original-style master SIGKILL produces actual orphan listener. Supervisor terminates/reaps only adopted workers and releases listener while healthy master/worker continues HTTP200. Exact PID/executable/signal/hash/exit and ownedcleanup receipts. Hostguard negative, existing harness tests, scoped validation and user-delegated same-author review.

handoff: Concrete original native cleanup50ms/SIGKILL leaves orphan nginx listeners; source/runtime failure retained in Spar. Implement optional owned-harness process supervision without changing Haskell/assertions or extending service timeouts.
